title: Lightly Toasted Egyptian Arabic Rice Pilaf
description: A simple, earthy and crumbly Egyptian dish featuring Arabic rice, tadka, and a touch of Mediterranean flavors. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the dried thyme, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper. Stir well.
Add the basmati rice and stir until the rice is well coated with the spices and oil.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the oil is hot, add 1 tablespoon of water to the saucepan and tilt it slightly to create a tadka.
Once the tadka is formed, carefully pour it over the cooked rice.
Fluff the rice with a fork to separate the grains.
Mix in the lemon juice and lactose-free or low-fat milk.
